findings.cause: CharacterPreviewStage creates direct/hemisphere lights but never sets scene.environment. Standard metallic materials lack environment specular illumination.
findings.proposed_fix: Capture built-in Three RoomEnvironment with PMREM for preview only, retain the themed scene background and direct lights, dispose the PMREM target on preview cleanup.

findings.cause: Skybox creates a radius-1400 sky sphere, then calls PMREMGenerator.fromScene(envScene, 0.04). Installed Three defaults to near=0.1, far=100. The sky triangles are beyond the cube cameras far plane, leaving the renderer clear color in the environment capture.
findings.proposed_fix: Pass an explicit far clip beyond the sky sphere (2000). Keep existing authored sky colors and lighting. Dispose temporary capture scene geometry/materials.

searched_resources: public .hdr/.exr/.ktx2/.env files; existing public textures are material SVGs and asset review PNGs, not reflection environments.
limits: Code-level diagnosis; no GPU readback/render comparison performed by this audit. Parent controls browser verification.
